set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- Every BorrowedNDArray operation is classified as borrowed view, owned result, or scalar observation.
- The matrix covers select, slice, narrow, reverse, permute, transpose, newAxis, squeeze, broadcastTo, reshapeView, reshape, reshapeCopy, contiguous, copy, flattenCopy, cast, convert, map, arithmetic, comparison, and array-valued reductions.
- Tests mutate the external backing buffer after each operation and assert the promised alias behavior.
- The known reshape and empty-axis sumAxes leaks are represented by regression tests.
- The suite runs on JVM and Scala.js where borrowing interop exists, with platform-specific adapters only at the borrowing boundary.
set.title: Build the borrowed-ownership state-machine regression matrix
